_comment: Swarm manifest (K26): the lead writes this BEFORE any worker starts. One entry per file, chain order. goal+tasks+context+dod = the worker's entire brief. Scriptable DoD lines: 'must contain:', 'no:', 'regex:', 'json:', 'min_kb:', 'max_kb:'; every other line goes to the one reviewer pass. Save as <circle>/plans/<cycle>.json; size with swarm_probe.py --manifest; accept with swarm_accept.py. estimate_tokens = the Lead's expected Claude tokens for the whole cycle (Lead + agents); order.py close compares it with the actual total (R-37).

files.goal: Facts with page marks extracted from the source report
tasks: drop bullets without a page mark

files.goal: Owner-facing decision memo built from the extracted facts
tasks: every number cites a page mark
dod: reads like a decision memo, not a template
